control: M=G+tanh(G)Z; G,Z independent standard Gaussians; Q=1+tanh(G)^2. A bounded predictable two-step Brownian integrand realizes this pair. Strict gap follows analytically from positive covariance of cosh(G) and exp(tanh(G)^2/2).
qualification: A counterexample to the displayed general equality, not to the paper main theorem; deterministic quadratic-variation bounds can instead use the exponential martingale.
